test_title: PYST 10: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 10 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
From among the words given in bold, select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the following sentence.

Reena, who **devoured **foreign **coloquialism** and **trivia**, **successfully** diverted the conversation.
solution:
The correct answer is, '**coloquialism**'

__
 
• The correct spelling is colloquialism.
 
• It means **(of language) used in ordinary or familiar conversation; not formal or literary.**
 
 
• Example - ***Andy can speak French but he struggles to understand certain colloquialisms.***
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Devoured** is correct. It means** to eat hungrily**.

 
 
• Example - ***Pam devoured that whole pizza in a minute.***
 
 
 
• **Successfully** means **completing the goal.**
 
 
• Example - ***He did it successfully***.
 
 
 
• **Trivia** is **a kind of game.**
 
 
• Example - ***Ray likes trivia.***
